facts.statement: Fossils of Procerosuchus come from the Late Triassic Santa Maria Formation in the Paleorrota Geopark of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, which dates to the Carnian age.
facts.quote: Fossils have been collected from the Late Triassic Santa Maria Formation in Geopark of Paleorrota, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, which is Carnian in age.

facts.statement: Initially, Procerosuchus was classified as a stagonolepidid alongside the genera Rauisuchus and Prestosuchus.
facts.quote: Initially, Procerosuchus was regarded as a stagonolepidid along with the genera Rauisuchus and Prestosuchus.

facts.statement: Friedrich von Huene later reassigned Procerosuchus to the family Rauisuchidae.
facts.quote: Later, it was reassigned by Huene to the family Rauisuchidae.

facts.statement: In 1972, Alfred Sherwood Romer assigned Procerosuchus as a possible member of the family Proterochampsidae.
facts.quote: In 1972, Romer assigned Procerosuchus as a possible member of the family Proterochampsidae.

facts.statement: Krebs in 1976, Chatterjee in 1985, and Carroll in 1988 all considered Procerosuchus to be a rauisuchid.
facts.quote: Krebs (1976) considered it to be a rauisuchid, as did Chatterjee (1985) and Carroll (1988).

facts.statement: Procerosuchus does not appear to belong to Clade X (now known as Poposauroidea), a monophyletic group of rauisuchians that includes poposaurids and ctenosauriscids.
facts.quote: Procerosuchus does not seem to belong to a recently identified monophyletic grouping of rauisuchians termed Clade X (and now known as Poposauroidea), which includes poposaurids and ctenosauriscids.

facts.statement: Initially, Procerosuchus was considered an aetosaurian, similar to other Rauisuchian genera like Prestosuchus.
facts.quote: Inicialmente, se consideró a Procerosuchus como un aetosauria igual que a otros géneros de Rauisuchia como Prestosuchus.

facts.statement: The correct taxonomy of Procerosuchus is still debated, and its anatomy has not been fully described.
facts.quote: La taxonomía correcta es aún objeto de debate (incluso el propio orden es ahora considerado parafilético) y la anatomía de los distintos taxones, incluyendo a Procerosuchus, no se ha descrito plenamente.

facts.statement: It has been suggested that Procerosuchus is a member of the subfamily Rauisuchinae.
facts.quote: Se ha sugerido que Procerosuchus es un miembro de la subfamilia Rauisuchinae.

facts.statement: Procerosuchus lived during the Ladinian stage, between 241.464 and 237 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Ladinian to Ladinian (241.464 to 237 million years ago)
